title: Platinum Rewards Card: Getting Started with Your Platinum Account

# Credit Cards Platinum Rewards Card

_Consolidated from 10 source document(s): doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_001, doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002, doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_003, doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_004, doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_005, doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_006, doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_007, doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_008, doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_009, doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_010_

### Source: doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_001
**Platinum Rewards Card: Getting Started with Your Platinum Account**

## Activate and Set Up
- Activate your card as soon as it arrives, then add it to your digital wallet for immediate use.
- Set up account alerts for transactions, payments, and unusual activity.

## Understand Your Rates and Limits
- Your purchase APR is 16.99% (variable). Review it in your account details before your first transaction.
- Typical approved credit limits range from $25,000 to $150,000. Your exact limit appears in your approval details.

## Payments and Autopay
- Choose an autopay option (minimum due, statement balance, or custom amount) to avoid interest and fees.
- The minimum monthly payment is 2.5% of your outstanding balance.
- A late payment triggers a fee of $32.50. Set due-date reminders to stay on track.

## Fees to Know on Day One
- Annual fee: $200.00.
- Foreign transaction fee: 0% on international purchases.

## Virtual Cards
- Free virtual cards are included: Yes. Use them to protect your primary card number for online purchases.
- Virtual card management is available in your account: Yes. Create, pause, or delete virtual card numbers as needed.

## First Purchases Checklist
- Confirm your billing address and contact details are current.
- Enroll in alerts and autopay.
- Add your card to frequently used merchants and services.
- Use virtual cards for new online merchants to reduce exposure.

## If You Are Still Applying
- Minimum credit score required: $750.

---

### Source: doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002
**Platinum Rewards Card: Earning 4% Cash Back**

## How You Earn
- You earn 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases.
- Returns or credits reduce previously earned rewards on a per-transaction basis.

## Eligible and Ineligible Transactions
- Eligible: point-of-sale and online purchases posted to your account.
- Not eligible: cash advances, balance transfers, fees, interest, and other cash-equivalent transactions.

## Posting Timeline
- Rewards accrue when transactions post to your account and typically become available after the purchase posts and clears any return window.

## Redeeming Your Rewards
- You can redeem once your available rewards balance reaches at least $15.
- Common redemption options include statement credits or other available channels in your account dashboard.

## Tips to Maximize Earnings
- Use the card for everyday spend to capture 10.0% on all categories.
- Set the card as your default payment at frequently used merchants.
- Consider your net rewards after the $200.00 annual fee when planning large purchases.

---

### Source: doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_003
**Platinum Rewards Card: Enhanced Fraud Protection Features Explained**

## What Is Included
- Enhanced fraud protection status: Yes.
- Real-time monitoring flags unusual transactions and prompts verification when needed.
- Quick fraud-alert handling with a target response within 17 minutes.

## Purchase Protection Window
- Items you buy are protected for $135 days from the purchase date, subject to coverage terms and exclusions. Keep receipts and order confirmations for claims.

## How Alerts and Verification Work
- When a transaction appears risky, you may receive an alert asking you to confirm or deny the charge.
- If you deny it, the transaction is declined and your card can be immediately secured while we investigate.

## Card Controls
- Temporarily lock your card if it is misplaced and unlock when found.
- Replace your card number quickly if compromise is suspected.

## Best Practices
- Enable transaction and international use alerts.
- Keep your contact details current so you receive time-sensitive prompts within the 17-minute response window.

---

### Source: doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_004
**Platinum Rewards Card: What to Do If You Suspect Fraudulent Activity**

## Take Immediate Action
1. Lock your card in the app to block new charges.
2. Review recent transactions and note anything unfamiliar.
3. Report the suspected fraud through the app or support channels. Enhanced protection is active: Yes.

## What Happens Next
- We aim to review fraud alerts promptly, with responses targeted within 17 minutes.
- If unauthorized activity is confirmed, we will replace your card number and assist with disputes for impacted transactions.

## Prepare Helpful Details
- Identify the date, amount, and merchant of any suspicious charges.
- Indicate whether your card was in your possession at the time.
- Provide any travel plans or unusual purchase patterns that may be relevant.

## Aftercare
- Monitor your account closely for additional alerts.
- Update any merchants or subscriptions with your new card details if your number is changed.
- Re-enable your card only when you are confident it is secure.

---

### Source: doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_005
**Platinum Rewards Card: Free Virtual Cards - How to Create and Manage**

## Availability
- Free virtual cards are included with your account: Yes.
- You can keep up to 30 active virtual cards at the same time.

## Create a Virtual Card
1. Open the virtual cards section in your account.
2. Select Create new virtual card.
3. Set optional controls such as nickname, spending limit, and merchant lock.
4. Save and copy the virtual card number, expiry, and security code for use at checkout.

## Manage Existing Virtual Cards
- Pause or unpause to temporarily stop transactions without deleting the card.
- Edit nickname and limits to match the merchant or subscription.
- Delete and replace cards when a merchant is no longer needed or if you suspect compromise.

## Best Practices
- Use a distinct virtual card per merchant or subscription for easier tracking and quick cancellation.
- Set conservative limits for new or unfamiliar merchants.
- Rotate or delete virtual cards used for one-time purchases.

---

### Source: doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_006
**Platinum Rewards Card: Using Virtual Cards for Online Shopping and Subscriptions**

## When to Use Virtual Cards
- Online checkouts with unfamiliar merchants to reduce exposure of your primary card number.
- Recurring subscriptions so you can pause or delete a specific merchant without affecting other services.
- One-time purchases where you prefer a card number you can retire after use.

## Capacity and Access
- Virtual cards are included with your membership: Yes.
- Maintain up to 30 active virtual cards at once to organize spend by merchant or purpose.

## Practical Tips
- Assign clear nicknames to match the website or app where the card is used.
- Set per-card limits aligned to expected monthly subscription amounts.
- If a merchant is compromised, delete that virtual card and create a new one without replacing your physical card.

## Cost
- There is no additional fee for using virtual cards beyond the standard annual fee of $200.00.

### Source: doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_007
**Platinum Rewards Card: Maximizing Your Premium Benefits and Rewards**

## Everyday Earning
- Use the card for daily purchases to earn 10.0% on all categories without rotating caps.

## International Spending
- Take advantage of 0% foreign transaction fees when traveling or purchasing from foreign merchants.

## Annual Fee Rebate Strategy
- Earn a $150.00 rebate on your annual fee by meeting a monthly spend threshold of $7500.00.
- Automate large, predictable expenses on the card to help consistently meet the threshold.

## Smart Redemption
- Redeem rewards once your balance reaches at least $15 to keep value working for you.

## Purchase Protection Use
- For eligible items, keep receipts and documentation to leverage purchase protection for up to $135 days after purchase.
- The maximum coverage per claim is $17,500, subject to policy terms and exclusions.

## Putting It Together
- Channel recurring bills, travel, and major purchases through the card to earn at the flat rate, avoid foreign fees, and meet the monthly threshold for the annual fee rebate.

### Source: doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_008
**Platinum Rewards Card: Referral Program - Earn Rewards for Referring Friends**

## How It Works
- Share your referral through your account to invite friends to apply.
- For each friend who is approved and meets the qualifying spend, you earn a referral bonus of $100.

## Qualifying Spend Requirement
- The referred friend must spend at least $1,500 within 90 days of account opening to qualify you for the bonus.

## Annual Limits
- You can earn up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year.

## Steps to Refer
1. Open the referrals section in your account.
2. Send your referral using the available sharing options.
3. Track the status of pending referrals in your dashboard.

## Payout Timing and Eligibility
- Bonuses are typically credited after the referred applicant is approved and meets the $1,500 spend requirement within 90 days.
- Self-referrals or duplicate applications do not qualify.

## Tips
- Share with friends who are likely to benefit from the card's features.
- Remind your referral to meet the $1,500 spend threshold within 90 days.
- Ensure your account is in good standing to receive bonuses promptly.

### Source: doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_009
**Platinum Rewards Card: New Customer Promo - First Year Annual Fee Waived**

## Offer Summary
- Apply during the promo window and, if approved, your first year annual fee is $0.00 instead of $200.00.

## Promo Window
- Start date: 2024-06-01
- End date: 2024-12-31

## How to Qualify
- Submit your application within the promo window and be approved.
- The waiver applies to the first 12 months from account opening; after the first anniversary, the standard $200.00 annual fee applies.

## What to Expect on Statements
- Your first statement should show no annual fee charge for the first year.
- If you see an annual fee during the promo period in error, contact support for correction.

## Important Notes
- The waiver cannot be retroactively applied to accounts opened outside the promo window.
- Closing and reopening an account does not guarantee eligibility; new approval during the promo window is required.

### Source: doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_010
**Platinum Rewards Card: Rebate Eligibility and Calcluation**

## Eligibility for the Annual Fee Rebate

- The Platinum Rewards Card annual fee rebate is earned only if you meet the required monthly spending threshold in every month of your cardmember year.
- A single month below the threshold disqualifies you from receiving the rebate for that entire cardmember year; there is no partial or prorated rebate.
- If your first cardmember year’s annual fee is waived under a promotional offer, the rebate does not apply to that year. Eligibility begins with the next cardmember year in which the annual fee is billed.

## How the Monthly Calculation Window Works

- Start date: Your first monthly window begins on your account opening date.
- Refresh cadence: Each new monthly window begins on the same calendar day each month (the monthly anniversary of your account opening) and ends the day before the next monthly anniversary.
- Cardmember year: Your rebate evaluation covers 12 consecutive monthly windows, starting from your account opening date (or from the start of the first fee-billed cardmember year after any promotional waiver).
- Posting date rule: Only transactions that post within a given monthly window count toward that month’s threshold. Authorization dates do not control eligibility.

### Example timeline (no amounts)
- Account opened on the 15th:
  - Month 1 window: 15th to the 14th (inclusive by posting date)
  - Month 2 window: 15th to the 14th
  - …
  - Month 12 window: 15th to the 14th
- You must meet the monthly threshold in all 12 windows to earn the rebate for that cardmember year.

## What Counts Toward the Monthly Threshold

Included
- Net purchases posted to your Platinum Rewards Card, including purchases made by authorized users.
- Purchases made using virtual card numbers associated with your account (counted the same as your physical card).
- International purchases, provided they post as purchases.

Excluded
- Fees, interest charges, and adjustments.
- Cash advances and cash-equivalent transactions (for example, money orders, traveler’s checks, and similar cash-like activity).
- Balance transfers.
- Person-to-person money transfers and funding transactions that are coded as cash equivalents.
- Disputed transactions while unresolved.

Adjustments
- Returns, refunds, or credits reduce the monthly total in the window in which the credit posts. A return that posts in a later month can cause you to miss the threshold for that later month.
- Merchant delays can affect posting dates; only posted transactions inside the window count.

## Evaluation and Rebate Posting

- Eligibility is assessed after the close of your 12th monthly window in the cardmember year.
- If you qualified, the rebate is applied as a statement credit to your Platinum Rewards Card account after the annual fee for that cardmember year is billed.
- If the account is closed or product-changed before the year-end evaluation or rebate posting, the rebate will not be awarded.

## Practical Tips

- Track posted transactions by your monthly anniversary dates, not by statement cycle or calendar month.
- Leave a buffer above the monthly threshold to account for late postings or potential returns.
- Confirm that authorized user and virtual card purchases have posted before the monthly window closes.
